fusions.name: Obsidian Nick
fusions.desc: Throws a flake of obsidian that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles, and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hidden Seam
fusions.desc: A cut into the weak seam that deals 22 damage, consumes every affliction on the target and adds 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Flint Underfoot
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to bury a flint spike at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles sets it off: it deals 24 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Clean Cut
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
